bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to economic development; appropriating money for a grant to HealthcareMN.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION.

(a) $200,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $200,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for a grant to HealthcareMN to support programs that improve healthcare innovation, entrepreneurship, economic growth, and community impact. These are onetime appropriations.

(b) Grant proceeds must be used to:

(1) host a healthcare venture summit to connect entrepreneurs, investors, and industry leaders and foster collaboration and investment in healthcare innovation;

(2) expand regional outreach to position the Twin Cities metropolitan area as a leading hub for healthcare innovation and enhance resources and partnerships across the ecosystem; and

(3) establish mentorship programs connecting healthcare innovators with corporate leaders and successful entrepreneurs to accelerate growth and market impact.
additions: (a) $200,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $200,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for a grant to HealthcareMN to support programs that improve healthcare innovation, entrepreneurship, economic growth, and community impact. These are onetime appropriations.
(b) Grant proceeds must be used to:
(1) host a healthcare venture summit to connect entrepreneurs, investors, and industry leaders and foster collaboration and investment in healthcare innovation;
(2) expand regional outreach to position the Twin Cities metropolitan area as a leading hub for healthcare innovation and enhance resources and partnerships across the ecosystem; and
(3) establish mentorship programs connecting healthcare innovators with corporate leaders and successful entrepreneurs to accelerate growth and market impact.
